ZXing Android Embedded 4.3.0 (Apache-2.0): https://github.com/journeyapps/zxing-android-embedded/tree/v4.3.0
ZXing Core 3.5.3 (Apache-2.0): https://github.com/zxing/zxing/tree/zxing-3.5.3
Both are unmodified upstream Maven dependencies. The source application uses an internal scanner Activity and only accepts the VeyPanel invitation format.
